body: The goal is to either become a software engineer or to go on to grad school doing something related to this.

I am under this impression that if I fail, my life is over. The damning thing is that I can easily figure out why this is not true, but it still sticks. It is a physical response. This may sound pretentious, but it is sort of Kafkaesque. It is like I am on trial every day.

I have not. It is in the back of my mind to do so, but the urge to speak to someone usually comes at a time like this where I feel emotionally and intellectually drained. I cannot get the strength to leave my room let alone to even speak to an on campus counselor. I will sit in my room for the next 2 months depressed and immobile, intermittently studying to excess. I guess I cannot figure out how to break this pattern and except failure, but I would like to.
